title: Three unions, and an ex-partner who remarried
goal: A reader can tell which of Dana's former partners also remarried, and trace each of the four children to exactly one couple without two couples' children ever sharing a line.

rubric.must: Lisa, the other wife of Dana's former partner Mark, stands on Mark's far side from Dana, not between any of Dana's partners.

Each child descends from a line that belongs to one couple only: Zoe from Mark and Lisa, Maya from Mark and Dana, Leo from Chris and Dana, Tess from Dana and Rick. No two couples' descent lines meet, overlap or share a sibling bar.
Every union line touches exactly its two partners; the union between Mark and Dana is routed around Chris rather than through him.
No two symbols overlap, no name or label overlaps another, and no line passes through a symbol or a name.
The legend shows male, female, index person, marriage/descent, divorced and living together.

ideal.notes: Lisa stands on Mark's far side, so every gap between neighbours carries one couple's children: Zoe from Lisa and Mark, Maya from Mark and Dana's union over Chris, Leo from Chris and Dana, Tess from Dana and Rick.
